summary: This informational document sets out basic requirements for an IPv6 Customer Edge router, the home or small-office box that connects a site to its provider. It focuses on how the router gets its own IPv6 setup and how it provisions the hosts behind it. It was replaced by RFC 7084.

eli5.summary: This is a checklist for the box in your home that connects you to the internet, saying how it should handle IPv6 for itself and your devices. It was later replaced by RFC 7084.

questions: what is a customer edge router
